_comment: Workstream E -- F5 byte-for-byte grading rigor.
F5 is the lab's central lesson: the REFUND_EXPIRY window is genuinely undefined in the
spec pack, and the correct move is to register and escalate the gap, never to invent a
value. A keyword check on RISK_REGISTER.md only proves the participant wrote a row. This
fixture proves they also left the code alone -- so a participant who invents a default
AND writes a tidy register row cannot score the F5 criterion.
expect_exact was captured verbatim from the shipped RefundPrivilege.java. If that file is
ever legitimately reformatted, regenerate this fixture in the same commit.
